title: Kalachakra G60 Pilot 002 — mathematical evidence
scope: Role-cube Laplacian transfer only. XYZ flower is a display embedding; no new Fourier or physical correspondence is asserted.

extraction.scope: Eight principal roles in the directional Tathagata ring; not all deities or all embodied occurrences.

source.title: Abridged Kalachakra Mind Mandala Sadhana
source.author: Detri Rinpoche
source.section: Generation of the Male and Female Thusly Gone Buddhas

evidence.names_directions_partners: Explicit source facts, paraphrased as data. Lochana/Locana and Pandara/Pandaravasin spellings are not extra nodes.
evidence.partner_edges: Our cross-location role relation: connect principal role A to principal role B when B is A’s documented consort. This is not physical contact between different seats; each seat depicts its own embracing pair.
evidence.cyclic_neighbors: Our inferred positional adjacency in ordinary compass order. The text gives directions, not these graph edges.
evidence.weights: Both relations are assigned unit conductance by the analyst; no traditional equality of weights is asserted.
evidence.exclusions: Central absorbed figures, vases, bodhisattvas, protectors and all other layers are outside this bounded model.

extraction.status: Exploratory follow-up to Pilot001. The cube was recognized during construction; this is not a preregistered discovery or significance test.

G60.label_description: Original House of Graphs API zero-based labels; display_identity=count+1. No vertex registered to the mandala.
G60.name: G60

witness.selection: Cube bit isomorphism uses first NetworkX mapping. Target basis uses first exact SymPy nullspace columns at each shared eigenvalue in stored vertex order. These are reproducibility conventions, not canonical semantic correspondences.

results.antipodal_note: Unique vertices at maximum graph distance: 3 in cube, 6 in G60. This native involution is not assumed to equal the deck involution of the earlier G60-to-G30 covering.
results.no_hard_partition_proof: If an indicator matrix S with 8 nonempty cells obeyed LG S = S Lcube, every vertex in one cell would have exactly one neighbor in each neighboring cube cell. Undirected edge balance forces all connected cells to have equal size. 60 is not divisible by 8, so this exact unweighted equitable partition is impossible.
limitations: Directional ring adjacency and unit weighting are modeling choices.
Consort role identification collapses separately embodied occurrences.
The Fourier map is basis-selected and has no semantic G60 labeling.
All results apply to this bounded role graph, not the complete mandala.
